summary: SVRN, Inc., the Greek-domiciled foreign private issuer formerly OceanPal Inc., filed a Form 6-K disclosing that Robert Perri resigned as Co-Chief Executive Officer effective October 7, 2026, departing without any stated disagreement over operations, policies or practices; he remains a consultant through December 31, 2026. Salvatore Ternullo, continuing as Chairman, becomes sole CEO, ending the co-CEO structure. The board also appointed Rabbina Aziz as Co-CFO alongside Vasiliki Plousaki and approved an amended equity plan reserving 10% of fully diluted shares, or 564,000 shares. Watch governance continuity and disclosure discipline.
